task.last_summary: blocked: I have identified a bug in `src/wrap.rs`. The condition `line_width + 1 + word.chars().count() <= width` uses `word.chars().count()` (number of characters) instead of `display_width(word)` (number of columns) when checking if a word fits on the current line. This causes issues when words contain wide characters (CJK), as the number of columns they occupy is greater than the number of characters. I will now proceed to fix this by replacing `word.chars().count()` with `w`.

The condition `line_width + 1 + word.chars().count() <= width` uses `word.chars().count()` (number of characters) instead of `display_width(word)` (number of columns) when checking if a word fits on the current line. This causes issues when words contain wide characters (CJK), as the number of columns they occupy is greater than the number of characters. I will now proceed to fix this by replacing `word.chars().count()` with `w`.
